title: Brazilian Chicken Leg Skewers
description: Grilled chicken leg skewers marinated in a mixture of Brazilian spices, perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together lovely brazilian seasoning mix, oil, lime juice, garlic, and onion.
2. Add the chicken legs to the marinade, turning to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
4. Thread the marinated chicken legs onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Grill the skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through and the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
6. Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
